confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Berlin, moved forward to July 2026 for assumed price growth and euro-dollar movement; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are moderately grounded; accommodation is least certain given wide July rate swings. Cocktail and wine_glass use the beer anchor as a reference (about 2.5 and 1.4 times a draft beer) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. FX 0.7002 is from search snippets attributed to the RBA homepage, not a page I opened; the snippet text was partly out of order and same-day third-party quotes ranged from about 0.6971 to 0.7010, so verify on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city was used; the basis is the model's general knowledge of Berlin's own price level.
